known_ambiguities: Opus origin_version labels repeats A/B as skillless, but origin_meta.skills says on.
Legacy Sonnet skill_on disables dynamic routing and lacks injected-skill identifiers.
The traced Sonnet flash subset disables controller routing and persists a changing skill library.
The Sonnet schema-curated and genuinely dynamic routed conditions remain separate panels; the latter uses a persisted, mutable skill library.

selection_policy.opus_no_skill: minimum eligible executed COSIM cycles across nominal skillless repeats A and B
selection_policy.post_hoc_partial_order: selected_skill_cycles < no_skill_cycles and all_positive_cycles < no_skill_cycles and no_skill_cycles < one_shot_cycles; no ordering is imposed between selected-skill and all-positive cycles

setup_summary.denominator_policy: all 26 kernels with an executed upstream baseline in schema-v2; a missing or ineligible setup result is not successful
setup_summary.gmean_policy: geometric mean of executed COSIM cycles on the identical all-setup eligible-kernel intersection
success_gate: recorded executed COSIM pass with positive cycles
